description: Reply to a message. Returns a preview and sends NOTHING unless confirm=true: review the preview, then call again with confirm=true to deliver.

attach.description: Absolute paths of files to attach.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send. Omitted or false returns a dry-run preview.

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

dryRun.description: Check the call and report what it would do, without doing it.

expectMessageId.description: Optional RFC Message-ID the id must still name: a row's messageIdHeader (request it with fields). On mismatch nothing happens and the error code is message_identity_mismatch.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

messageId.description: Compound message ID from mail_list output.

to.description: Override the reply-to addresses. Defaults to the original sender.
